acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Doppelgangers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Mimic, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Mirror-Error Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Near-perfect human copy betrayed by faint jaw seams and one hand jointed the wrong way.
Signature mechanic: One Error Copy: the near-perfect human copy mirrors the target's last committed posture, but one hand bends the wrong way and pulls a faint jaw seam open.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a reactive copy specialist that perfectly mirrors one action except for a wrong hand joint and jaw seam.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 blank smooth flesh and one featureless limb gain an external ember boundary without marking the body; T2 the partial copy and unfinished arm gain a heat-black copied-surface edge; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand gain cooling channels; T4 layered faces and mask edges gain ceramic heat clasps; T5 body-wide faces and mask crown gain bounded ignition latches.

Motion/process branches: T1 the blank featureless limb drives one external combustion cycle around its silhouette; T2 the partial copy sheds smoke only from its finished surface; T3 the wrong hand opens the jaw-seam vent; T4 layered faces rotate heat from one mask clasp; T5 body-wide faces ignite and cool one mask-crown latch.
counterplay: Feed a short recoverable motion, move opposite the wrong hand, and strike the open jaw seam before the copy corrects. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the blank smooth-flesh featureless limb opens its external cooling boundary after combustion; T2 the partial copy exposes a heat sink at the unfinished arm; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand expose the active vent after correction; T4 layered faces expose the cooling mask clasp after rotation; T5 body-wide faces expose the mask-crown ignition latch between cycles, preserving copy readability.
forbiddenTreatments: Fire effects that hide the borrowed-versus-native boundary
identityInvariants: A generic humanoid copy silhouette retains one deliberate flaw until layered face and mask motifs appear at explicit upper tiers.
Clay-grey skin, putty, borrowed colors, porcelain, copied cloth, and smooth flesh remain discrete source materials rather than Earth affinity.
Seams, wrong joints, ill-fitting clothes, and layered masks reveal copy quality while preserving the readable original-copy relationship.
Disguise fidelity escalates from an entirely blank true form to a sovereign carrying many stolen-looking faces at once.
telegraph: Borrowed clothing settles into exact symmetry while the wrong hand rotates one joint too far and the jaw seam pales.
